notes.title: The Jig Is Up!
notes.content:
[p][b]The Jig Is Up![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173854/db4c82410cd55fe2f41f4f3347b327e3317815d0.png"][/img]
I wanted to officially announce that we will be attending a convention and will be showing off the game in an early demo.

What does this mean for [u][b]you[/b][/u]?

A [b]FREE[/b] EARLY DEMO WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR [u][b]EVERYONE[/b][/u] ON AUGUST 9TH!

We are super excited to not only show off the game at the convention but for everyone to see the kind of procedural world we are building.

This demo is small since it needed to be done before our due date but we will ensure that the game's foundation has hit all the correct marks. We want good feedback so that we can make the foundation as perfect as it can be before going into full development time. 

We are so thankful for every one of our supporters and players. We cannot wait to give you a taste of what we have been working so hard for.

Thank you.

- Gavin[/p]

notes.title: Beta 1.6
notes.content:
Beta Update 1.6

RELEASE DATE: 10/24/2023

Update Size: ~TBD

NEW FEATURES:

Added Coin Pickups!
Added Wall Climbing system (In Progress)
Reworked combat system from ground up
Added in a new combat detection system
Reworked mob ai and logic to perform better
Experimenting with character customization system
Improved mob path tracing and detection
Sub menu now works inside of the inventory

SMALL CHANGES:

Changed the frequency of mob spawning in day
Tweaked oceans, sky, and weather
Improved Dev Workflow
Updated Game Launching Photos

CHANGES TO COME:

Fully Fledged Gliding/Flying System
Flying Animal(s)

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 1.5.2
notes.content:

Added New Inventory Character View
Added custom trigger box for stating location name and songs to play in specific areas
Added Custom NPCs
Added custom path tracing system for NPCs
Partially added dialogue system for NPCs
Added NPC Jobs, Names Generator
Fixed Player States being Messed up
Added Footstep Sounds for all walking areas
Added Custom Stamina Wheel
Added UE5 Logo to game start
Added NorwinLabs Logo to game start
Added Detail to WaterfallRise
Fixed player location saving in saved games
Added Custom door component that can be opened
Fixed Audio playing while the game is paused
Fixed dropping Items bug
Added money system (Herons)

SMALL CHANGES:

Improved Dev Workflow
Updated UI elements
Added 2nd layer of clouds to Overworld
Updated Game Launching Photos

CHANGES TO COME:

Fully Fledged Gliding/Flying System
Flying Animal(s)

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update

notes.title: Beta 1.4.0
notes.content:
Beta Update 1.4.0

Update Size: 14MB

NEW FEATURES:

- Main Menu has been Overhauled for a more clean and consistent experience
- The first town is called Waterfall Rise
- Waterfall Rise (WR) has 4 main islands and is where Garth, Robin, and Red live
- UI has been Overhauled
- Combat System is in full-swing development
- You can do quick and strong attacks (left click or shift + left click)
- Updated version tag at the top of the screen for ease of debugging during Beta
- Many more bugs fixed (Thanks for reporting)

SMALL CHANGES:

- Foliage lags way less
- FPS should be more stable

CHANGES TO COME IN THE NEXT UPDATE:

- Water will become swimmable

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update

notes.title: Beta Update 1.3
notes.content:
Another Beta update was just posted!

Beta Update 1.3

Update Size: 308.7MB

NEW FEATURES:

- Inventory System is Completed
- Added Hover Tooltips for Items
- You can now place down items (Chests)
- You can now drag and drop items from the inventory
- Added a version tag at the top of the screen for ease of debugging during Beta
- New Terrain Generation Layout
- Many bug fixes (Thanks for reporting)

SMALL CHANGES:

- Tweaked world generation
- Edited foliage spawning / working on the world generation system
- Game movement should be much smoother
- FPS should be more stable

CHANGES TO COME IN THE NEXT UPDATE:

- Water will become swimmable
- Combat System will be started
- Animal AI spawning system will be improved

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update
